svg.title: Research areas
svg.desc: Four research areas: light-injection attacks on cameras; autonomous vehicle and cyber-physical security; bio-hybrid robotics; smart manufacturing and CCTV safety monitoring.

g.text: Found physical-layer flaws in nine smart cameras, including
Google Nest, Amazon Ring and Arlo, and built training-free
detection, sensorless feed recovery and a lens shield.
Cyber-Physical Security Lab, advised by Dr. Yazhou Tu
perception (detection, lanes, depth), plus SLAM/IMU fusion,
GPS spoofing defense and BCI prosthetic security.
Robotic and prosthetic systems that make decisions with
biological neurons and sense touch through hydrogel and
NiFELab, Chemical Engineering, with Dr. Jean-François Louf
Plant-management software, machine data collection and
automation, and computer-vision CCTV monitoring that checks
ICAMS Lab, Industrial Engineering, with Dr. John Osho
